analysis.summary: Under masked MXCSR, MAXSS maps a NaN quotient to 0.05; JBE is taken on equality or unordered, and that target applies the add/store.

observations.claim: Confirmed: `divss %xmm6,%xmm1` computes xmm1=xmm1/xmm6. With masked invalid, 0/0 yields NaN; then `maxss %xmm7,%xmm1` has dest=xmm1, src=0.05 and returns the valid source 0.05, so the NaN quotient is not retained. Nonzero finite numerator / zero divisor yields signed infinity; +inf survives maxss, -inf is raised to 0.05.

Confirmed: `ucomiss %xmm1,%xmm0` compares xmm0 as first/dest (elapsed from 0x18) against xmm1 as second/src (clamped quotient). `jbe 0x140af7862` is taken when xmm0<=xmm1 ordered, i.e. CF=1 or ZF=1, and also unordered; it is not taken only when xmm0>xmm1 ordered. Equality therefore branches to the target.

Confirmed: target 0x140af7862 applies the update: xmm0 still holds loaded elapsed, `addss 0x28(%rax),%xmm0` adds the delta, then stores to 0x18(%r11). NaN elapsed makes ucomiss unordered, so JBE reaches this target and applies the update; it is not pending/deferred.

branch_matrix.effect: Fall through; later L23-L26 load delta, add current 0x18(%r11), and store updated value
JBE 0x140af7862; A2 adds delta to xmm0 (current elapsed) and stores at 0x18(%r11)
UCOMISS sets CF=ZF=PF=1; JBE taken to 0x140af7862; A2 performs add/store, so NaN elapsed is applied

branch_matrix.condition: Quotient NaN before maxss (e.g. 0/0, masked invalid)
branch_matrix.effect: MAXSS writes source 0.05 into xmm1; NaN clamp does not survive

branch_matrix.condition: Finite nonzero numerator / zero divisor, masked divide-by-zero
branch_matrix.effect: DIVSS yields signed infinity; +inf remains, -inf is replaced by 0.05 by MAXSS

side_effects.order: Target path order at 0x140af7862: rax=rbp-0x38; xmm0=xmm0+0x28(rax); 0x18(r11)=xmm0; jump 0x140af7722
Fallthrough path order: xmm0=0x28(rax); xmm0=xmm0+0x18(r11); 0x18(r11)=xmm0; this path is skipped when JBE is taken

unknowns.question: Are invalid and divide-by-zero FP exceptions masked at this site?
unknowns.needed_evidence: MXCSR mask bits at execution, not supplied

integration_checks: Preserve AT&T operand order: `maxss %xmm7,%xmm1` compares/clamps xmm1 against 0.05; `ucomiss %xmm1,%xmm0` compares elapsed xmm0 against quotient xmm1.
Treat JBE target 0x140af7862 as an applied update path, including unordered/NaN and equality cases.
